title: Company Launches Operations in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
summary: Our company in Ho Chi Minh City in October 2024, with the team eager for future growth.
body_markdown: Despite temporary working conditions, our company officially launched operations in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam this October 2024. While we eagerly await the completion of our dedicated office space, the Vietnam team is full of enthusiasm for the opportunities ahead and the contributions we’ll make as we continue to grow.
